key_facts: Oxygen saturation of 85% on room air
Coarse rales at the lung bases bilaterally
Nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction
Chest radiography suggestive of bilateral multifocal pneumonia
Normal sinus rhythm with normal frontal QRS axis on ECG

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including fever, anosmia, and shortness of breath, combined with the nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction and chest radiography suggestive of bilateral multifocal pneumonia, are consistent with COVID-19 pneumonia.

rejected.label: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS)
rejected.why: While the patient has severe respiratory symptoms and low oxygen saturation, ARDS is a complication that can arise from various conditions, including COVID-19 pneumonia, but it is not a primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Influenza pneumonia
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and positive nasopharyngeal swab by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction are more specific to COVID-19 pneumonia, and there is no mention of influenza testing.
